name: Factory
description: An agent-native platform for software development built around 'Droids' — autonomous coding agents that plan, edit, and run tasks across a codebase. Works from a CLI/SDK and runs agents both in the cloud and locally in the background. Model-agnostic across frontier and open-weight models.

modelSupport.notes: Supports leading frontier and open-weight models.
